### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. epidermolysis bullosa simplex due to plakophilin deficiency  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.435)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-6809371)

**Proposed mechanism:** CDSN (HGNC:2391) —DISRUPTS→ keratin intermediate filament organization (GO:0008518); PKP1 (HGNC:9357) —DISRUPTS→ keratin intermediate filament organization (GO:0008518); keratin intermediate filament organization (GO:0008518) —LEADS_TO→ Hypotrichosis (HP:0000984); keratin intermediate filament organization (GO:0008518) —LEADS_TO→ Epidermolysis bullosa simplex (HP:0007374). Mutations in CDSN (leading to hypotrichosis 2) and PKP1 (leading to epidermolysis bullosa simplex) both disrupt the organization of keratin intermediate filaments, a shared pathway essential for epidermal integrity, ultimately manifesting as distinct but related epidermal phenotypes.

**How to falsify it:** A demonstration that mutations in CDSN and PKP1 affect entirely independent cellular pathways with no overlap in downstream effects on epidermal structure would falsify this hypothesis. Specifically, if CDSN mutations primarily affected hair follicle development independent of keratinocyte structural integrity, and PKP1 mutations solely impacted desmosome function without affecting keratin filament organization, this link would be invalidated. _(variant: Presence of pathogenic variants for both CDSN and PKP1 in gnomAD with a frequency >0.1% would cast doubt on their causality in rare diseases.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of CDSN and PKP1 in keratin intermediate filament organization could reveal common therapeutic targets for improving epidermal and hair follicle integrity in both hypotrichosis and epidermolysis bullosa.

---

#### 2. arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia 9  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.388)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-6809371)

**Proposed mechanism:** Pathogenic PKP2 variant (rsXXXXXXX) —DISRUPTS→ PKP2 (HGNC:9017); PKP2 (HGNC:9017) —DISRUPTS→ Desmosome assembly (GO:0034330); Desmosome assembly (GO:0034330) —LEADS_TO→ Arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia 9 (MONDO:0012180); Desmosome assembly (GO:0034330) —LEADS_TO→ Hypotrichosis 2 (MONDO:0007805). Pathogenic variants in the PKP2 gene disrupt the assembly of desmosomes, leading to cellular adhesion defects that manifest as arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia 9 in the heart and hypotrichosis 2 in the skin.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in PKP2 that are exclusively associated with one of the two diseases, or demonstration of distinct molecular pathways for each disease independent of desmosome function. _(variant: The absence of any common pathogenic variants in PKP2 within the gnomAD database for individuals presenting with hypotrichosis 2 would weaken the link if ARVD9 is strongly linked to a specific pathogenic variant.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of PKP2 and desmosome integrity in both cardiac and epidermal development may lead to novel therapeutic strategies targeting cell adhesion for both arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathies and certain forms of hair loss.
